description:
Triage output after the severity floor has been applied.

``severity`` and ``final_severity`` are the same value. ``llm_severity`` is
what the model returned, and is unset when structured output never validated.

final_severity.description: The more severe of the model severity and the floor.

llm_severity.description: Severity the model returned. Unset when triage degraded.

severity.description: Severity stored on the run. Equals final_severity.
